decisions.decision: 03-11: renamed getActivePayments to getPayments rather than keeping the name
decisions.rationale: The query behind it stopped filtering isActive. A name promising 'active' while returning paused rows is exactly how a total silently starts counting the wrong thing. The rename forces every call site to be revisited via compile error. Verified: only one consumer exists (recurring_payment_cubit.dart:65), so nothing silently changed meaning.

decisions.decision: 03-10: did NOT add confirmDismiss to the debt swipe
decisions.rationale: The undo SnackBar is the recovery mechanism. A confirmation dialog would tax every correct swipe to guard against the rare wrong one.

decisions.decision: 03-12 will remove the duplicate amount parser but NOT fix the shared one
decisions.rationale: The shared parseAmountCentsOrNull PT-BR separator bug is a standing, deliberately deferred task. Fixing it inside a plan scoped to one call site would change behaviour for all five.
